rationale: Select the intermediate weight 0.70: normalized temporal proxy decreases 33.45%, while departure from current predictions is below alpha085. E4 candidate visuals are close, so this is a conservative stability/responsiveness choice, not a proven optimum or selection solely by the smallest temporal error. The full course rollercoaster sequence has not been inferred/reviewed for tuning.
